examples.english: A trapezoid has one pair of parallel sides.

notes:
{台形|だいけい} is a mathematical term for a quadrilateral with exactly one pair of parallel sides (trapezoid in American English, trapezium in British English).

PARTS OF A TRAPEZOID:
- ⟦{上底|じょうてい}→上底：noentry⟧: upper base (shorter parallel side)
- ⟦{下底|かてい}→下底：noentry⟧: lower base (longer parallel side)
- ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧: height (perpendicular distance between bases)
- ⟦{脚|きゃく}→脚：noentry⟧: legs (non-parallel sides)

FORMULA:
⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ = (⟦{上底|じょうてい}→上底：noentry⟧ + ⟦{下底|かてい}→下底：noentry⟧) × ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧ ÷ 2
